description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs an asynchronous pipeline for a voice interaction system. It integrates various speech and language processing services, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, large language models, and a custom transport mechanism, to facilitate a conversational AI system with event handlers for client connection events.

classes.name: HeyGenTransport
classes.description: A transport class for interfacing with the HeyGen API, handling input/output streams and events.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents conversational context for the LLM, holding message history and related parameters.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates and manages the pairing of context and user parameters for LLM interactions.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a sequence of processing steps for the speech and language pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration options for a pipeline, such as metrics enablement.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution of pipeline tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Sets up and runs the entire audio and language processing pipeline asynchronously.

methods.name: on_client_connected(transport, client)
methods.description: Event handler invoked when a client connects; initiates conversation.

methods.name: on_client_disconnected(transport, client)
methods.description: Event handler invoked when a client disconnects; cancels active tasks.
